dedupe_keys.name: monitoring data of the openlab research bridge part 1 reference condition

description: This data paper and repository record describe monitoring data from the openLAB research bridge, a 45-metre prestressed concrete bridge built in the IDA-KI project to study damage detection under controlled conditions. Part 1 covers the reference condition from 1 February to 31 October 2024 under monthly simulated traffic loads. It holds acceleration from six IEPE accelerometers at 500 Hz when triggered, tilt from six MEMS tiltmeters with temperature and humidity, and air temperature, humidity and solar radiation every 10 minutes. Andreas Jansen, Max Herbers, Bertram Richter and colleagues published it on 7 May 2025 in the OPARA archive with a DOI, as CSV files with standard column names, free under CC BY-SA 4.0. Coverage is one test structure. Caveats: this is the undamaged reference phase only, with later parts for induced defects published separately, and one bridge cannot represent a network. It suits digital twin and resilience studies that need labelled structural monitoring data for algorithm validation. No closely related catalogue record was identified in this pass.
